item.title: 29-year-old WA trooper killed in Tacoma identified
item.description: Tributes pour in from across the state following news of WSP Trooper Guting being killed in the line of duty on Friday night.

item.title: Seattle weather: Scattered lowland showers as mountain snow piles up
item.description: Saturday started off relatively mild with light showers. In our full forecast, Nikki Torres explains when to expect more rainfall for the lowlands and snowfall for the higher elevations.

item.title: Gov. Ferguson, local leaders update WA residents on flooding response
item.description: "There has been historic stress," the governor said, on Washington's levee infrastructure. There will be 24/7 spotters from the national guard watching for breaches over the Christmas holiday.

item.title: Seattle weather: A Wet Winter Solstice
item.description: Unsettled weather ahead with lowland rain and mountain snow. Winds will be breezy on Sunday and Monday. Christmas Day will begin chilly with a possibility of a wintry mix.

item.title: Seattle Kraken snap four-game losing streak, beat Sharks 4-2
item.description: Ryan Lindgren had the tiebreaking goal early in the third period for his first score with Seattle, and the Kraken beat the San Jose Sharks 4-2 on Saturday night to snap a four-game losing streak.

item.title: Multiple weekend crashes leave WA troopers injured or killed
item.description: The Washington State Patrol is mourning the loss of one of their own, while two additional troopers were hospitalized over the weekend following multiple crashes on state roads.

item.title: Driver fleeing police hits family of four in Puyallup, WA
item.description: A 4-year-old is in critical condition and three other family members are hospitalized after a man fleeing police ran a red light on Sunday morning.

item.title: Seattle weather: Occasional rain for Christmas week
item.description: The lowlands can expect scattered rain Sunday into Monday. At times, the rain could be heavy. We can't rule out isolated thunderstorms with small hail.

item.title: Second driver involved in WA trooper death, police hunt for truck
item.description: Police now believe a second driver was involved in the death of a 29-year-old Washington State Patrol trooper on Friday. They ask the public for help as the hunt is underway.

item.title: Abbey Levy makes 26 saves as Seattle Torrent fall 3-1 to Fleet
item.description: Daniela Pejšová and Riley Brengman scored first-period goals to lead the Boston Fleet to a 3-1 victory over the Seattle Torrent on Sunday night.
